name: The Ritz Carlton, Sanya
positioning: Beachfront resort in Sanya, Hainan, officially named The Ritz-Carlton Sanya, Yalong Bay, with villas, a three-level spa and a kids club
best_for: Families who want a kids club and a beach resort
Travelers who want villas with private pools
Golfers who want a resort with a golf shuttle

facts.text: The hotel is in Sanya, a beachfront city on the southernmost tip of Hainan Island.
The resort sits along a secluded beach in Hainan province.
The Club Lounge is on the 6th floor with an ocean view of Yalong Bay.
Sofia serves Italian cuisine, including homemade pasta and Neapolitan-style pizzas baked in an open-fire oven.
Sand is at the beachside and offers grill, deli and beverages.
Fresh 8 is an interactive buffet restaurant with show kitchens.
Scene, the lobby lounge, has views of the South China Sea and serves Afternoon Tea, light bites and cocktails.
The spa also has an outdoor pool, courtyards, whirlpools, relaxation rooms and a jade steam room.
A complimentary shuttle service runs to Sanya Duty-Free Mall.
A complimentary shuttle runs between the hotel and Yalong Bay Golf Club and Sun Valley Golf Club.
The fitness center has a separate Kinesis Studio for Technogym's cable-based Kinesis system.

highlights.text: Lagoon Rooms are on the first floor and let guests swim into the lagoon pool from their balcony steps.
Villas have one to three bedrooms, a private pool, a sala and a lotus water pond.
The spa is set across three levels, with locally inspired therapies using ingredients such as coconut milk, bamboo and Himalayan salt.
Pearl serves Cantonese dishes in a contemporary interpretation, plus Hainan and Sichuan dishes.
Ritz Kids offers complimentary access with an indoor and outdoor playground.

considerations.text: Club Lounge access comes with a Club Level room, or by purchasing a Daily Access Pass subject to availability.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing and a remote tropical location that may require longer travel time.
